about.title: A 3D engineer who ships systems, not demos
about.lead: I build production VR, AR and digital-twin software for organisations that have to trust it.
body: My work sits where spatial craft meets real operational systems: training simulators that have to match procedure exactly, AR guidance that has to survive a noisy work site, and digital twins built on open government geodata rather than invented numbers.

I work end to end — concept, 3D, engineering and delivery — which is why this portfolio is itself a working piece: the same renderer that draws the hero loads a real Dutch district from open 3DBAG building data.
